lyrics.ja: 「せーのっ！」
lyrics.en: "Ready, set!"

lyrics.ja: 「ケ・セラ・ソラ！」
lyrics.en: Que sera, sora!

lyrics.ja: おはよう　朝日に今日もご挨拶
lyrics.romaji: Ohayou Asahi ni Kyou mo Goaisatsu
lyrics.en: Good morning—greeting the morning sun again today
lyrics.zh: 早安，今天也向朝陽問候

lyrics.ja: …ってあれ？ウソ！もうこんな時間！？
lyrics.en: ...Wait, huh? No way! It's already this late!?

lyrics.ja: 午後から予定あるのに　すぐに支度をしなきゃ
lyrics.romaji: Gogo kara Yotei Aru no ni Sugu ni Shitaku wo Shinakya
lyrics.en: I have plans from the afternoon—I have to get ready right away
lyrics.zh: 明明下午有約，得趕快準備才行

lyrics.ja: いってきまーす！
lyrics.en: I'm off!

lyrics.ja: 慌てて飛び出して気付く
lyrics.en: I rush out in a hurry and realize
lyrics.zh: 慌慌張張衝出門才發現

lyrics.ja: こっちじゃなーいっ！ここどこ！？
lyrics.en: This isn't the way! Where am I!?

lyrics.ja: 助けてあん肝～っ！
lyrics.en: Help me, ankimo!

lyrics.ja: トラブルばっか　転んで起きての毎日です
lyrics.romaji: Toraburu Bakka Koronde Okite no Mainichi Desu
lyrics.en: It's a daily life of nothing but trouble—falling down and getting back up
lyrics.zh: 盡是麻煩，跌倒了再爬起來的每一天

lyrics.ja: 何でも思い通りとか　そんなおいしい話は無いけど
lyrics.romaji: Nandemo Omoi Doori to ka Sonna Oishii Hanashi ha Nai kedo
lyrics.en: Things don't always go my way—there's no such sweet deal
lyrics.zh: 凡事都如願這種好事雖然不存在

lyrics.ja: 心の曇り空を晴らす合言葉　唱えたら
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro no Kumori Zora wo Harasu Aikotoba Tonaetara
lyrics.en: But if I chant the password that clears the cloudy sky of my heart
lyrics.zh: 只要唸出驅散心中陰霾的通關密語

lyrics.ja: ね？ほら、快晴でしょ？
lyrics.en: See? Look—it's clear skies, right?

lyrics.ja: ずっと皆に届けたい　歌もダンスも元気も
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Minna ni Todoketai Uta mo Dansu mo Genki mo
lyrics.en: I want to always deliver to everyone—songs, dances, and energy
lyrics.zh: 想一直傳達給大家，無論是歌曲、舞蹈還是活力

lyrics.ja: きっと同じ空の下　笑顔も分け合えるよ
lyrics.romaji: Kitto Onaji Sora no Shita Egao mo Wakeaeru yo
lyrics.en: Under the same sky, we can surely share our smiles too
lyrics.zh: 在同一片天空下，笑容也能彼此分享

lyrics.ja: ちょっと疲れちゃうときも　涙が出そうなときも
lyrics.romaji: Chotto Tsukarechau Toki mo Namida ga Desou na Toki mo
lyrics.en: Even when I'm a little tired, even when tears are about to fall
lyrics.zh: 即使有點疲憊的時候，即使快要流淚的時候

lyrics.ja: いつもの魔法の言葉　今日も
lyrics.romaji: Itsumo no Mahou no Kotoba Kyou mo
lyrics.en: The usual magic words—today too
lyrics.zh: 那慣用的魔法話語，今天也

lyrics.ja: ケセラセラのそら
lyrics.en: Que sera sera's sky

lyrics.ja: 「せーのっ！」
lyrics.en: "Ready, set!"

lyrics.ja: 「ケ・セラ・ソラ！」
lyrics.en: Que sera, sora!

lyrics.ja: こんそめ！
lyrics.en: Consommé!

lyrics.ja: 今日も一日頑張ろーっ！
lyrics.en: Let's do our best again today!

lyrics.ja: カメラにマイクに…よし、準備オッケー！
lyrics.romaji: Kamera ni Maiku ni... Yoshi, Junbi Okkee!
lyrics.en: Camera and mic... Alright, ready to go!

lyrics.ja: お水もちゃんとあるし
lyrics.en: I've got water too

lyrics.ja: 備えさえあれば嬉しいね！(？)
lyrics.en: As long as we're prepared, we're happy! (?)

lyrics.ja: それじゃ　今日は何をしようかな
lyrics.romaji: Sore ja Kyou ha Nani wo Shiyou Kana
lyrics.en: So then, what should I do today?

lyrics.ja: お歌に雑談に…　あっ！
lyrics.en: Singing, chatting... Ah!

lyrics.ja: ホラボコラベ～！
lyrics.en: Look, Boko Rabe!

lyrics.ja: 皆と笑い飛ばせば
lyrics.en: If I laugh it off with everyone

lyrics.ja: また明日もハレバレだ！(よっしゃ！)
lyrics.en: Tomorrow will be bright and cheerful again! (Alright!)
lyrics.zh: 明天也會晴朗開朗！（好耶！）

lyrics.ja: ホッと　ため息こぼして
lyrics.en: Letting out a sigh of relief

lyrics.ja: ふと夜空を見上げたら
lyrics.en: When I suddenly looked up at the night sky

lyrics.ja: パッと　満天の星たちが
lyrics.romaji: Patto Manten no Hoshi Tachi ga
lyrics.en: Suddenly, a sky full of stars

lyrics.ja: キラキラ瞬いてた
lyrics.en: Was twinkling brightly

lyrics.ja: ずっと追いかけ続けたい　雲より高い夢でも
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Oikake Tsuzuketai Kumo yori Takai Yume demo
lyrics.en: I want to keep chasing forever—even dreams higher than the clouds
lyrics.zh: 想一直追尋下去，即使是比雲更高的夢想

lyrics.ja: もっと強く羽ばたいて　空まで駆けてゆくよ
lyrics.romaji: Motto Tsuyoku Habataite Sora made Kakete Yuku yo
lyrics.en: Flap my wings even stronger and race up to the sky
lyrics.zh: 更用力地振翅，奔跑到天際

lyrics.ja: そっと背中押すような　温もりに包まれたら
lyrics.romaji: Sotto Senaka Osu You na Nukumori ni Tsutsumaretara
lyrics.en: When wrapped in a warmth that gently pushes me forward
lyrics.zh: 被溫柔推動背脊的暖意包圍時

lyrics.ja: いつまでも止まらないよ
lyrics.en: I'll never stop

lyrics.ja: 今日も、明日も、ずっと
lyrics.en: Today, tomorrow, forever

lyrics.en: Que sera sera's sky
